name: Touken Ranbu -ONLINE- 2021 Booster Box Case
cleanName: Touken Ranbu ONLINE 2021 Booster Box Case
extDescription: Each sealed booster box case contains 24 booster boxes of 16 packs. (each pack contains 7 random cards with two of them being R or greater rarity)

name: Mikazuki Munechika
extDescription:
[AUTO](RC)[1/turn]:When this unit attacks, perform all of the following according to the number of cards in your damage zone.
•3 or more cards - This unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
•4 or more cards - Look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or bottom of your deck.
•5 or more cards - [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], and [Stand] this unit.
extFlavorText: “I'm Mikazuki Munechika. My name comes from the crescent moon shapes on my blade. Nice to meet you.”

name: Oodenta Mitsuyo
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit's attack hits, if you persona rode this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it.
extFlavorText: “Odenta Mitsuyo, one of the Tenga Goken. Perhaps you should have just left me sealed in the storage shed...”

name: Juzumaru Tsunetsugu
extDescription: [ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Rest] this unit and one of your other rear-guards], choose one of your opponent's units, and it gets [Power] -5000 until end of turn. If you persona rode this turn, [Stand] all of your rear-guards.
extFlavorText: “My name is Juzumaru Tsunetsugu. I hold faith with the Buddhism doctrines, searching for an answer in the long period of time, where even the values of humans change.”

name: Onimaru Kunitsuna
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000/[Critical] +1 until end of that battle. At the end of that battle, put this unit on the bottom of your deck.
extFlavorText: “...I'm Onimaru Kunitsuna. I saw it in a dream. The arrival of an oni at your doorstep.”

name: Shokudaikiri Mitsutada
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and all of your front row units get [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's front row rear-guards, and retire it.
extFlavorText: “I'm Shokudaikiri Mitsutada, named after...a candlestick I cut in two. I know, pretty lame, right?”

name: Kasen Kanesada Kiwame
extDescription:
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1 & Rest] any number of your rear-guards], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn for each unit [Rest] for this cost.
[CONT](VC):During the battle that this unit attacked, if this unit's [Power] is 30000 or greater, when your opponent would call cards from their hand to (GC), they must call two or more at the same time.
extFlavorText: “What do you make of these clothes? Can you see the intent to convey a sense of gracefulness?”

name: Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki Kiwame
extDescription:
[CONT](VC):If your opponent has no back row rear-guards, this unit gets [Power] +2000. (Active on opponent's turn too)
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose one of your opponent's back row rear-guards, and retire it. Then, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle for each of your opponent's open back row (RC).
extFlavorText: “I'm only tryna match my master's ambitions. Nothing else. Now, what d'ya say we go conquer the world?”

name: Yamanbagiri Kunihiro Kiwame
extDescription:
[CONT](VC):If you persona rode this turn, this unit gets [Critical] +1.
[AUTO](VC):You may pay "[Soul-Blast 1 "Yamanbagiri Kunihiro Kiwame"" for this cost. When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], draw a card, choose up to one card from your hand, and call it to an open (RC).
extFlavorText: “Being a reproduction no longer bothers me. My role as a Touken is to serve you. That's all I ever needed.”

name: Hachisuka Kotetsu Kiwame
extDescription: [CONT](VC):If you have five rear-guards, all of your front row rear-guards get [Power] +5000, and all of your back row rear-guards get "boost". (Active on opponent's turn too)
extFlavorText: “Behold the splendor of a true Kotetsu. I'll soon show you my looks don't deceive, master.”

name: Tsurumaru Kuninaga
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], choose one of your other rear-guards in the same column as this unit, and swap its position with this unit.
extFlavorText: “Hey. I'm Tsurumaru Kuninaga. You really lucked out getting me in your ranks. Even if I do say so myself...”

name: Iwatooshi
extDescription: [CONT](RC):If you have four or more grade 1 or less units, when this unit would attack a vanguard, it also battles all of your opponent's grade 2 or greater rear-guards.
extFlavorText: “Huh, kinda small, aren't ya? Well, I guess everyone is small compared to Benkei though, ha! Call me Iwatooshi, nice to meet ya.”

name: Ichigo Hitofuri
extDescription:
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have three or more rear-guards with "Toushirou" in their card names, this unit gets [Power] +10000.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if this unit's [Power] is 30000 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 2], and this unit gets [Critical] +1 until end of that battle.
extFlavorText: “My name is Ichigo Hitofuri. I am the sole tachi created by the hand of Awataguchi Yoshimitsu.”

name: Ookanehira
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks while not boosted, [COST][discard two cards from your hand], choose one of your units with [Power] greater than this unit, and this unit's [Power] increases or decreases to 5000 greater than that unit's [Power] until end of that battle.
extFlavorText: “I'm Ookanehira, a blade of unparalleled beauty and dignity chosen by none other than Ikeda Terumasa. However...”

name: Uguisumaru
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one "Ookanehira" from among them, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck. If you did not reveal a card, [Counter-Charge 1].
extFlavorText: “I'm Uguisumaru, from Kobizen. I've got no idea why I'm called that. Maybe it means something, maybe it doesn't. Anyway, looking forward to working with you!”

name: Hotarumaru
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, it gets [Power] +10000 instead of +5000.
[AUTO]:When this unit is retired from (RC) during your opponent's turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and put this card from your drop into your hand.
extFlavorText: “I'm Hotarumaru, all the way from Aso Shrine! Tadaaa! Nailed it.”

name: Monoyoshi Sadamune
extDescription: [CONT]Back Row (RC):When this unit's [Power] would be increased by your trigger effect, double the value of that increase. (If +10000, it becomes +20000)
extFlavorText: “Hello, I'm Monoyoshi Sadamune! I might just be your lucky sword!”

name: Taikogane Sadamune
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose up to two cards from your hand, and call them to open (RC). If you called two cards, draw a card.
extFlavorText: “I'm the one and only Taikogane Sadamune. Let's go crazyyy!”

name: Kousetsu Samonji
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand] and this unit gets [Shield] +10000 until end of that battle.
extFlavorText: “I am Kousetsu Samonji. I long to see a world where we are no longer called upon to fight...”

name: Izuminokami Kanesada
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks while boosted, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], until end of that battle, this unit gets [Power] +5000, and if it is boosted by "Horikawa Kunihiro", when your opponent would call cards from their hand to (GC), they must call two or more at the same time.
extFlavorText: “I'm Izuminokami Kanesada. Strong and stylish. Stylishly strong. It's no wonder I'm so popular these days!”

name: Horikawa Kunihiro
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts a "Touken Danshi - Uchigatana", [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & discard a card from your hand], draw a card, and if it is boosting "Izuminokami Kanesada", this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “Hello? Oh, hello! You wouldn't happen to have seen my partner around here would you? Izuminokami Kanesada. Me? Oh, yeah! I'm Horikawa Kunihiro!”

name: Higekiri
extDescription: [CONT](RC)/(GC):If "Hizamaru" is on your (GC) or front row (RC), this unit gets [Power] +5000/[Shield] +5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)
extFlavorText: “Greetings, I am Higekiri, treasure of the Genji clan. You are the one who will wield my power this time around, yes?”

name: Hizamaru
extDescription: [CONT](RC)/(GC): If "Higekiri" is on your (GC) or front row (RC), this unit gets [Power] +5000/[Shield] +5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)
extFlavorText: “I am Hizamaru, the (other) treasure of the Genji clan. Mayhap, my brother is already here?”

name: Ookurikara
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks while not boosted, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle. If you have no face up cards in your damage zone, it gets [Power] +15000 instead of +10000.
extFlavorText: “I'm Ookurikara. I've got nothing to say to you. Let's get this over with.”

name: Shishiou
extDescription:
[CONT](RC):This unit cannot be chosen by your opponent's card effects.
[AUTO](RC):When your vanguard's attack hits, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], draw a card, and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “I'm Shishiou, the jet black tachi. I'm pretty stylish, huh? Now I'm here, you'd better make good use of me.”

name: Kogarasumaru
extDescription: [CONT][Front Row (RC)]:When your [OVER] trigger would be removed by its trigger effect, you may put it into your hand instead of removing it.
extFlavorText: “My name is Kogarasumaru. It is my destiny to engage in battle. That has not changed in a thousand years, nor will it ever.”

name: Kenshin Kagemitsu
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle that this unit boosted, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & put this unit into your soul], draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “I'm Kenshin Kagemitsu. Don't go underestimating me!”

name: Tonbokiri
extDescription:
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
[AUTO](RC)[1/turn]:When this unit is [Rest] by a card's cost, [Stand] this unit.
extFlavorText: “It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am known as Tonbokiri. I am yours to command.”

name: Koryuu Kagemitsu
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], and draw a card.
extFlavorText: “I'm Koryuu Kagemitsu. Just a lonesome traveler looking for a place to call his own...”

name: Kasen Kanesada Toku
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Kasen Kanesada Kiwame", [Soul-Charge]1, choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “How cruel this world is, that art cannot be cultivated without power...”

name: Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki Toku
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki Kiwame", [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose up to one of your opponent's back row rear-guards, and retire it. If no units were retired, draw a card.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “Hahaha! Looks like I'm moving up in the world!”

name: Yamanbagiri Kunihiro Toku
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding on "Hachisuka Kotetsu Sentou", [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Urashima Kotetsu", call it to (RC), and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “A counterfeit could never reach these heights!”

name: Hachisuka Kotetsu Toku
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding on "Hachisuka Kotetsu Sentou", [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Urashima Kotetsu", call it to (RC), and shuffle your deck.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “A counterfeit could never reach these heights!”

name: Nagasone Kotetsu
extDescription: [CONT](RC):If you have another unit with "Kotetsu" in its card name, this unit gets [Power] +5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)
extFlavorText: “I'm Nagasone Kotetsu. I may be a forgery, but I'll work as hard as any real Kotetsu sword.”

name: Taroutachi
extDescription: [CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have a "Jiroutachi" on your (RC), this unit gets [Power] +10000.
extFlavorText: “...Oh, I walk the material plane once more. I am Taroutachi, a sword no common mortal was ever able to wield in battle.”

name: Jiroutachi
extDescription: [CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have a "Taroutachi" on your (RC), this unit gets [Power] +10000.
extFlavorText: “Hey, so I'm the beautiful Jirou! Why, you aren't rocking too much. Well, regards to you!”

name: Nihongou
extDescription: [CONT](RC):During the battle that this unit attacked, if it is the first battle of this turn, this unit gets [Power] +10000.
extFlavorText: “I'm Nihongou, one of Japan's greatest spears. I haven't kept you waitin' too long, have I?”

name: Otegine
extDescription: [CONT](RC):If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, when this unit would attack, it battles all of the units in one of your opponent's columns.
extFlavorText: “I'm Otegine, one of the Tenga Sanmeiso, the finest of all spears. I'm not great at hacking or slashing, but if it's piercing action you want, I'm your man!”

name: Hyuuga Masamune
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top or bottom of your deck.
extFlavorText: “I'm Hyuuga Masamune. I've drifted my way to this place.”

name: Yamanbagiri Chougi
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have no other units in the same column, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle. At the end of that battle, move this unit to the back row.
extFlavorText: “I'm the original creation by Chougi, Yamanbagiri. What's wrong? Staring at me so intently.”

name: Hakusanyoshimitsu
extDescription:
[CONT]:Sentinel(You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. If your hand has two or more cards, choose a card from your hand, and discard it.
extFlavorText: “I am Hakusanyoshimitsu. A sword forged by Yoshimitsu. I am also used as a dowry item and a tool to pray for the afterlife. I ask for your care.”

name: Nankaitarouchouson
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit attacks, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and perform one of the following. If you retired your opponent's back row rear-guard this turn, perform all of them instead.
•This unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
•Draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and discard it.
extFlavorText: “I am Nankaitarouchouson. Call me Chouson if you find it too long.”

name: Hizen Tadahiro
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When the attack this unit boosted hits a vanguard, if your opponent's back row rear-guard was retired this turn, choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.
extFlavorText: “…Hizen Tadahiro. I'm used to seeing blood. So, who's next?”

name: Suishinshi Masahide
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When your vanguard is placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Minamoto Kiyomaro", call it to an open (RC), and shuffle your deck.
extFlavorText: “I am Suishinshi Masahide. Don't underestimate me just because I was born in peace.”

name: Minamoto Kiyomaro
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When your vanguard is placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to one "Suishinshi Masahide", call it to an open (RC), and shuffle your deck.
extFlavorText: “I'm Minamoto Kiyomaro. Inheriting the name from one of the three famed creations. Nice to meet you.”

name: Sanchoumou
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), if you persona rode this turn, [Counter-Charge 1].
extFlavorText: “Ah, the birds are calling. One of the thirty-five selected by the Uesugi family, unmarked. You can call me Sanchoumou. Have the birds from my clan gathered yet?”

name: Kokindenjunotachi
extDescription: [ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose one of your rear-guards, [Stand] it, and it gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “...I, Kokindenjunotachi, am here.”

name: Jizou Yukihira
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit is [Rest] by a card's cost, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “Lives connected. /I suppose this is karma... Jizou Yukihira, reporting.”

name: Kogitsunemaru
extDescription: [CONT](VC/RC):If this unit's [Power] is 13000 or less, this unit cannot attack.
extFlavorText: ““Small fox”? Who told you that's what my name means? No, no, no. It's “grand fox”. I'm the greatest, grandest fox of them all!”

name: Sohayanotsurugi
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & discard a card from your hand], choose one of your vanguards, search your deck for up to one card with the same card name as that card, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
extFlavorText: “Sohayanotsurugi Utsusunari, these are the words carved in to my blade. Just a replica of a greater sword.”

name: Namazuo Toushirou
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose a "Honebami Toushirou" from your drop, and call it to an open (RC).
extFlavorText: “My name is Namazuo Toushirou. I've got a pretty patchy memory but that's not going to stop me doing my job!”

name: Honebami Toushirou
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose a "Namazuo Toushirou" from your drop, and call it to an open (RC).
extFlavorText: “My name is Honebami Toushirou. Other than my name, I have few memories.”

name: Hirano Toushirou
extFlavorText: “I am Hirano Toushirou. Please allow me to accompany you.”

name: Gotou Toushirou
extFlavorText: “Hey, I'm Gotou Toushirou. I know, I know; pretty tall for a tantou, right!”

name: Shinano Toushirou
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When the attack this unit boosted hits, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & put this unit into your soul], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.
extFlavorText: “I'm Shinano Toushirou. Not to brag, but I'm by far the prettiest of all of my brothers!”

name: Maeda Toushirou
extFlavorText: “Greetings. My name is Maeda Toushirou. I shall serve you in perpetuity.”

name: Akita Toushirou
extFlavorText: “Hi, hi, I'm Akita Toushirou. Wow, the outside is so pretty!”

name: Yagen Toushirou
extDescription: (You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck)
extFlavorText: “Hey, Captain. The name's Yagen Toushirou. Looking forward to working with ya.”

name: Houchou Toushirou
extDescription: [CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have another unit with "Toushirou" in its card name, this unit gets [Power] +5000.
extFlavorText: “Hai hai, I'm Houchou Toushirou. I like candy and good cooks! And more candy!”

name: Akashi Kuniyuki
extDescription:
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have a "Aizen Kunitoshi" on your (RC), this unit gets [Power] +5000.
[CONT](GC):If you have a "Hotarumaru" on your (RC), this unit gets [Shield] +5000.
extFlavorText: “Hullo. I'm Akashi Kuniyuki. Nice to meet ya!”

name: Aizen Kunitoshi
extDescription:
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have a "Aizen Kunitoshi" on your (RC), this unit gets [Power] +5000.
[CONT](GC):If you have a "Hotarumaru" on your (RC), this unit gets [Shield] +5000.
extFlavorText: “Hullo. I'm Akashi Kuniyuki. Nice to meet ya!”

name: Sengo Muramasa
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & Rest] two of your other rear-guards], your opponent chooses one of their rear-guards, and retires it.
extFlavorText: “Ha ha ha ha. You may call me Sengo Muramasa. That's right, the demon blade! Ha ha ha ha.”

name: Kikkou Sadamune
extDescription:
[CONT](RC):You may choose to not [Stand] this unit in your stand phase.
[AUTO](RC):At the beginning of your main phase, if this unit is [Rest], choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “I'm Kikkou Sadamune. What does my name mean? Can't a poor sword have a little secret or two?”

name: Daihannya Nagamitsu
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed for the first call this turn, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. (Can activate when multiple units are called at the same time)
[CONT](RC):When you would look at your deck, you can only look at the top card of your deck. (When searching your deck or looking at two or more cards, look at only the top card instead. Resolve all other effects normally)
extFlavorText: “It is a pleasure to meet you. My name is Daihannya Nagamitsu. I am the crowning achievement of the swordsmith Nagamitsu, from the Osafune school.”

name: Souza Samonji
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from hand, if you have two or more [Rest] units, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and draw a card.
extFlavorText: “My name is Souza Samonji. Do you also desire to wield me merely as a symbol of conquest?”

name: Sayo Samonji
extDescription: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if you have three or more other [Rest] units, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.
extFlavorText: “I am Sayo Samonji. Do you also seek revenge?”

name: Kasen Kanesada Sentou
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Kasen Kanesada Toku", choose one of your vanguards, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “I am Kasen Kanesada, a sword of Nosada!”

name: Kasen Kanesada
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.
extFlavorText: “Greetings. I am Kasen Kanesada, a man of culture and purveyor of fine arts. I hope that our time together is pleasant and refined.”

name: Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki Sentou
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki Toku", choose up to one of your opponent's back row rear-guards, and retire it. If no units were retired, [Soul-Charge]1.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “Alright, the battle begins!”

name: Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.
extFlavorText: “I'm Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki. Let's start with some light exercise, then we can think about taking over the world!”

name: Yamanbagiri Kunihiro Sentou
extDescription:
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Yamanbagiri Kunihiro Toku", [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and draw a card.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “…Here I go!”

name: Yamanbagiri Kunihiro
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.
extFlavorText: “Yamanbagiri Kunihiro. You don't have to say anything. I know, you're disappointed that I'm just a copy...”

name: Yamabushi Kunihiro
extDescription:
[CONT](GC):If your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, this unit gets [Shield] +5000.
[AUTO]:When this unit is retired from (RC) or (GC), [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and put this card on the bottom of your deck.
extFlavorText: “Bwahaha! My name is Yamabushi Kunihiro. I have dedicated my life to reaching enlightenment!”

name: Hachisuka Kotetsu Sentou
extDescription:
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1 & reveal two cards with "Hachisuka Kotetsu" in their card names from your ride deck], choose a card from your drop, and put it into your hand.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000.
extFlavorText: “Hachisuka Kotetsu, moving in!”

name: Hachisuka Kotetsu
extDescription: [AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.
extFlavorText: “I'm Hachisuka Kotetsu. I am most positively, most definitely, 100% NOT a fake. Understand?”

name: Urashima Kotetsu
extDescription: [CONT](RC):If you have another unit in the same column as this unit, this unit gets [Power] +5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)
extFlavorText: “How's it going? I'm Urashima Kotetsu! Wanna explore the Dragon Palace with me? We'll need to work out how to get there first, though.”

name: Doudanuki Masakuni
extDescription: [ACT](RC)[1/turn]:If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
extFlavorText: “I'm Doudanuki Masakuni. If you ask me, weapons just need to be strong. If we're fit for purpose, appearances shouldn't matter. Simplicity and fortitude is the best, isn't it?”

name: Tomoegata Naginata
extDescription: [ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose two of your units, and they get [Power] +2000 until end of turn.
